user.title: Flexible Horseshoe Card (Integration)
user.description: Set up the Flexible Horseshoe Card for Home Assistant. You can optionally enable the included demo dashboard to explore FHS using entities from your own system.

data_description.demo_dashboard: Makes a community dashboard with example Flexible Horseshoe Card configurations. The dashboard can be added in Settings -> Dashboards -> Add Dashboard, 'Community Dashboards'

demo_entities.title: Demo dashboard entities
demo_entities.description: Choose Home Assistant entities for the community dashboard. All fields are optional. Examples that do not have a matching entity are disabled.

data_description.temperature_entity: Used by temperature and history examples.
data_description.humidity_entity: Used by humidity and history examples.
data_description.switch_entity: Used by interactive switch and light examples.
